notes: All three with-skill runs used Mode B (single context): the executor subagents had no subagent-launching tool. Mode A (true isolation) is NOT covered by these evals and must be checked from a main session.

S saturates on rich descriptions: in incident-alerting-cycle1 six of eight vectors got S=3 and three tied at P=27, so the map stops discriminating. The S scale (3 = 'two or more independent markers') is likely too easy to max out.
Fatal threshold may be loose: vector 3.1 reported 5 other fatal candidates out of 10 laws in one zone.

In b2b-sales-cycle2 the baseline copied the matrix format from the prompt, so assertions on cycle header, 8 rows, quota and no-advice do not discriminate there; the discriminating ones are the cycle modifiers (open breach carry-over, immunity, blind-spot).
Cost: with skill ~+38k tokens and ~+125 s per run on average; the gate case is cheaper with the skill (stops early).
Assertions are structural; whether the breaches are real and well-argued needs the Arbiter's judgement in the Outputs tab.
